task: Replace the opaque manual source-artifact hash step in the strict external evaluator handoff with a reproducible artifact derived from an exact Git commit.
objective: Create and validate a deterministic tracked-source archive whose digest is directly bound into the strict evaluation request.

executor.role: O semantic execution, implementation, falsification, and validation stage

success_conditions: The artifact is reconstructed from an exact canonical commit rather than the mutable working tree.
Dirty tracked changes and untracked files do not alter the artifact for the same commit.
A different commit changes the tracked-source artifact digest when the tree changes.
The strict evaluation request subject uses the reconstructed artifact digest and exact commit.
The exact head passes full CI before merge.
actions: Added commit verification, tree identity, tar archive SHA-256/size metadata, and archive validation.
Added regression tests covering dirty/untracked invariance, commit sensitivity, request binding, tampering, canonical ids, and CLI create/validate round-trip.
Verified head a53a9f6ac41dcf2d9f5d6c6a3fbe2caaaa563a7d with CI run 32044318820 and merged PR 150 as 3ec632e2e7a9663a70bbd92c8d1d5a14a9a070d1.
decisions: Use the immutable commit object as the source of truth for tracked source and explicitly exclude dirty/untracked working-tree state.
Keep source artifact creation separate from evaluator independence: the artifact and request are scaffolding, not production evidence.
Continue after merge toward tighter full-system subject binding and independent evaluation readiness.
observations: The previous strict request accepted a caller-supplied artifact SHA-256; PR 150 now provides a mechanically derived path for tracked source.
Source identity alone does not freeze the external model/runtime identity, independent evaluator, hidden suite, or production result.
claims: Tracked source for an external handoff can now be deterministically bound to an exact Git commit and validated against its archive SHA-256.
AGI remains unverified because the strict independent production evidence gate has not passed.
unknowns: How to bind the externally executed model/runtime identity as tightly as the source artifact remains an open system-subject question.
Whether independent evaluators will complete the strict production protocol remains unknown.
unresolved: Bind an explicit public runtime/system manifest to the strict evaluation request so external evidence identifies source plus the model/runtime under test.
Exercise longer genuine-model continual campaigns with fresh transfer/retention boundaries.
Obtain genuinely independent signed production evidence for every criterion and both required evaluator groups.
